# `subject.pause`

Pause a subject (reversible).

- **group:** `mutation`
- **posture:** `reversible`
- **CLI:** `operator-voice subject-pause`
- **MCP tool:** `subject_pause` (mutation — hidden unless explicitly enabled)

## Arguments

| name | type | required | help |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subject_id` | `str` | required |  |

## Examples

```
operator-voice subject-pause --subject-id subj_abc123
```
